headline: Nifty gains on Brent crude pullback, but analysts warn of continued volatility
summary: The Nifty 50 gained as Brent crude pulled back toward $101-102 a barrel and weaker-than-expected US jobs data eased concerns about a Fed rate hike. Analysts warned markets are likely to stay volatile near term.
why: The Nifty 50 is India's benchmark index of large listed companies, and India is a major oil importer, so crude prices affect its market.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: The index rose as lower crude prices and softer US data eased pressure on Indian equities.
